sources.snippet: We present ImmuVis, a family of efficient foundation models for imaging mass cytometry (IMC), a high-throughput multiplex imaging technology that handles molecular marker measurements as image channels and enables large-scale spatial tissue profiling. Unlike natural images, multiplex imaging lacks a fixed channel space, as real-world marker sets vary across studies, violating a core assumption ...

sources.title: ImmuVis: Hyperconvolutional Foundation Model for Imaging Mass Cytometry
sources.snippet: ImmuVis outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and ablations in virtual staining and downstream classification tasks at substantially lower compute cost than transformer-based alternatives, and is the sole model that provides calibrated uncertainty via a heteroscedastic likelihood objective.
